title: QE reference route to dev08
detail: dft5090 reports pw.x 7.6 (orig-mpi-dfti, MPI, MKL) reachable on dev08, idle, key ssh, scp exchange. Reported not verified; see docs/reference-environment.md. First real run happens in P6.

title: Si.pz-vbc.UPF approved for internal use; provenance unverified
detail: Used for the first real run (R1) with the user's approval; provenance still unverified, stated in docs/validation.md.

title: FFT backend decided
detail: ADR 0004: ndrustfft over rustfft. NEON effect still unmeasured.

title: codex mcp-server removed from Codex CLI
detail: Using codex exec through scripts/delegate.sh (approved by the user). Verified by the smoke test and the P0 run.

title: Codex sandbox blocks network
detail: No external crates in P0. Crates must be vetted and fetched by Claude.

title: delegate.sh fork mode untested
detail: new and resume verified in real runs (resume needed three wrapper fixes). fork still unverified.

title: Engine LICENSE not decided
detail: Left to the user; no GPL code is copied.

title: Complex linear algebra backend decided
detail: ADR 0004: faer for complex Hermitian eig and GEMM, LAPACK kept as test oracle. Evidence in docs/backend-spike-results.md.

title: Codex sandbox cannot commit in a worktree
detail: Git metadata lives outside the worktree folder. Claude commits after verification.

title: Existing hand-written Accelerate FFI conflicts with library policy
detail: Hand-written FFI deleted in P1A; zero unsafe in the workspace.

title: Debug-mode spike test took 707 s
detail: Spike code not merged (tag spike/p0c). Rule added: tests over about 10 s in debug must be #[ignore] with a release command.

title: upf crate is new and little used
detail: Materialized on the real file: the upf crate failed on newline-separated arrays (fixed by whitespace normalization in P2C). Real-file fields cross-checked against dft5090's report. Keep watching for further deviations in other UPF files.

title: Spherical Bessel and Y_lm hand-written
detail: No suitable permissive light crate (scilib is GPL-3.0; scirs2-special not trialed). Verified by identities and closed forms, not by a library oracle.

title: Minimal FFT grid changes XC energy by 1e-7 Ha
detail: QE's automatic FFT grid equals ours at 30 Ry and at the other five scanned cutoffs (24, 24, 30, 36, 36, 45 cubed). Energy change between 25^3 and 40^3 in our code: 4e-8 Ha.

title: Real-file deviations were invisible to synthetic fixtures
detail: Three real-world UPF deviations (relativistic=no, newline-only arrays, functional label with NOGX NOGC) needed fixes found only on the real file. Lesson: add real-format variants to fixtures for each new file used; fixtures now cover them.

title: Constant 2.56e-6 Ha offset vs QE explained quantitatively
detail: Offset is cutoff independent (2.545 to 2.565e-6 Ha over 20 to 80 Ry). Matches the mesh-origin segment omitted by a direct Coulomb-subtracted integral of the local potential: 8*2*4*pi*Z*r0^2/(2*Omega) = 2.548e-6 Ha. Our erf-subtracted route is the more accurate. QE internals not inspected, so stated as consistent with. See docs/validation.md R4.

title: QE k-point evidence for 4x4x4 is a relayed text summary
detail: The full 27 kB qe.out stayed on dev08 (sha256 c93d458b...); only the k list and eigenvalue blocks were relayed as text. The two smaller runs were transferred whole and hash-verified.

title: Public repository push needs exposure review
detail: Local main is 86+ commits ahead of the public origin. The tree and history contain the internal address of dev08 (192.168.0.228, in tests/reference/reports), host names dev08 and dft5090, a local-hostname author email, and numbers derived from a UPF of unverified license (the UPF itself is not committed). Waiting for the user's decision.

title: Performance comparison with QE needs a Rust toolchain on dev08
detail: dev08 has no rustc or cargo and 16 GB free disk. Installing a toolchain there needs the user's approval; the comparison is only meaningful on the same machine with matched threading.

title: rust-dft is about 2x (Gamma) to 5x (32 k points) slower than QE on one core (was 10 to 100x)
detail: Same node, same accuracy class: after O1 to O4c and k-point threads rust-dft is 2.0x (Gamma) and 5.8x (32 k points) slower than QE with one process at conv_thr 1e-12, and 8x (32 k) at 1e-8; with equal cores 4.1 to 5.2x for 32 k points. Remaining: per-iteration FFT and linear algebra cost, Davidson iteration count (QE-informed tuning in progress: P7P7), about 2.2 s of sequential work around the solves (next ticket), FFT lane layout (P7P9).

title: 원소 라벨과 의사퍼텐셜이 맞는지 검사하지 않음(Fe 라벨에 Si 파일을 연결해도 성공)
detail: P8E 조사에서 확인: species 라벨은 별칭일 뿐이라 잘못된 의사퍼텐셜을 연결해도 경고 없이 계산이 성공합니다. 다른 물질을 계산하고도 성공으로 보일 위험. 해결: 입력 사전 검사(원소 식별, UPF 헤더의 원소와 대조, validate가 SCF 설정도 검사). 티켓 대기열에 추가 예정.

title: 8원자 셀 Davidson 미수렴(기본 여분 밴드 4개에서만 발생)
detail: 맨 위 밴드가 축퇴된 묶음 한가운데에 걸려 400회 반복에도 잔차 4e-6에서 정체. 여분 밴드 1, 8, 12개에서는 수렴하고 에너지가 4e-13 Ha 안에서 일치. P7PC가 버퍼 밴드 허용오차 정책으로 수정 중.

title: P10B native MKL numerical and performance acceptance pending
detail: No MKL runtime on Apple Silicon. Claude must run crates/dft-mkl/tests/dev08.sh using existing remote UPF and MKLROOT=/opt/intel/oneapi/mkl/2026.1. ABI, strict 1e-13 FFT agreement, 1e-12 Ha SCF agreement, thread bit identity, QE and performance gates are unverified. Default remains Rust; no performance recommendation yet.
